quote: In keeping with the “case-by-case approach” taken by our sister circuits, see id. at 89–90 (discussing cases in other circuits and concluding that reports of a circuit split are “greatly exaggerated” and that the cases reflect a “nuanced” and “case-by-case” approach), application of Rule 9(b) in this Circuit is subject to important caveats.
cite: United States v. Amerisource Bergen Corp., No. 25-2950 (2d Cir. 2026)
